author: National Geographic
description:
Legendary director, Steven Spielberg, shares his exclusive story behind the making of the iconic film, JAWS (1975), now considered the first modern blockbuster. Featuring interviews with Cameron Crowe, James Cameron, J.J. Abrams, Jordan Peele, Guillermo del Toro, Emily Blunt, and many more, this film delves into the creation and impact of the shark film over the course of the 50 years since it first premiered.
